reason: 4x area supersampling softened broken strokes but did not establish a clear native-size readability improvement on the small actual failure. Close this tuning branch.
size_estimator: Height of the nonzero ink-support bounding box at final output resolution using the unchanged Run 23 renderer. Not the full label height or padded source ROI height.
below_minimum: abstain_small_text; return unchanged input and report missing text unresolved
at_or_above_minimum: eligible_for_visual_review_only; size alone does not approve restoration
unverified_cases: abstain when existing Run 23 alignment or ink checks abstain
calibration_note: 15px is a conservative operational guard, not a validated human-readability threshold. The observed small case is excluded; intermediate sizes are untested. A larger controlled example is only a candidate, not evidence of generalization.
user_constraints: Do not enlarge the product or change a required viewpoint without permission in the brief. If readable label size cannot be achieved within allowed composition, abstain.
next: One larger-label ad workflow to measure actual usefulness, setup time and manual intervention; no additional small-label filter tuning. Gate 2 structural requirements still apply.
